volkswagen-group.name: Volkswagen Group
volkswagen-group.description: Volkswagen Group is a German multinational automotive manufacturing group headquartered in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany. It is one of the world's largest automakers by vehicle sales and the largest in Europe.

veolia.name: Veolia
veolia.description: Veolia Environnement S.A. is a French transnational company headquartered in Aubervilliers. It operates in water management, waste management, and energy services, traditionally managed by public authorities.

verizon.name: Verizon
verizon.description: Verizon Communications Inc. is an American telecommunications company headquartered in New York City. It is the world's second-largest telecommunications company by revenue and operates the largest wireless carrier network in the United States. The company was founded as Bell Atlantic Corporation and renamed Verizon in 2000 after merging with GTE.

vtb-bank.name: VTB Bank
vtb-bank.description: VTB Bank is a Russian majority state-owned bank with headquarters in various federal districts of Russia and a legal address in Saint Petersburg. Over 90% of its capital stock was owned by three Russian agencies as of 2022. It operates in the financial sector.

vivendi.name: Vivendi
vivendi.description: Vivendi SE is a French investment company headquartered in Paris. It wholly owns Gameloft and holds investments primarily in content, entertainment, media, and telecommunications companies.

volvo-cars.name: Volvo Cars
volvo-cars.description: Volvo Car AB, trading as Volvo Cars, is a Swedish multinational manufacturer of luxury vehicles headquartered in Torslanda, Gothenburg. The company produces SUVs, station wagons, and sedans.

vmware.name: VMware
vmware.description: VMware LLC is an American cloud computing and virtualization technology company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It was the first commercially successful company to virtualize the x86 architecture. In 2023, Broadcom acquired VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction, and its end-user computing division was sold and rebranded to Omnissa.

victorias-secret.name: Victoria’s Secret
victorias-secret.description: Victoria's Secret is an American lingerie, clothing, and beauty retailer founded in 1977. The company expanded rapidly under Les Wexner after 1982, growing to 350 stores nationally and becoming the largest lingerie retailer in the United States by the early 1990s.

vertiv.name: Vertiv
vertiv.description: Vertiv Holdings Co. is an American provider of infrastructure and services for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, Vertiv operates in more than 40 countries with around 34,000 employees and 30 manufacturing and assembly facilities.

vestas.name: Vestas
vestas.description: Vestas Wind Systems A/S is a Danish company that manufactures, sells, installs, and services wind turbines. Founded in 1945, it operates manufacturing plants in multiple countries including Denmark, Germany, and the United States. The company employs 37,000 people globally.

vallourec.name: Vallourec
vallourec.description: Vallourec S.A. is a multinational manufacturing company based in Meudon, France. It specializes in hot rolled seamless steel tubes, expandable tubular technology, automotive parts, and stainless steel for energy, construction, automotive, and mechanical industries.

vonovia.name: Vonovia
vonovia.description: Vonovia is a European multinational real estate company based in Bochum, Germany. It owns around 530,979 apartments in Germany, Sweden, and Austria and is a member of the DAX 40 and STOXX Europe 600 blue-chip indexes.

viacom.name: Viacom
viacom.description: Viacom Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate focused on film and television. It was split from the original Viacom in 2005, with National Amusements as the controlling shareholder. The split created a new Viacom and CBS Corporation.

vk.name: VK
vk.description: VK, formerly Mail.ru Group until October 2021, is a Russian technology company founded in 1998. It began as the parent company of the Mail.ru email service and has become a major player in the Russian-speaking internet segment.

valid.name: Valid
valid.description: Valid S.A. is a Brazilian engraving company headquartered in São Paulo. It provides security printing services to financial institutions, telecommunication companies, state governments, and public agencies in Brazil, Argentina, and Spain.

vend-marketplaces.name: Vend Marketplaces
vend-marketplaces.description: Vend Marketplaces ASA operates marketplaces in Northern Europe and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway. The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and led by CEO Christian Printzell Halvorsen.

vivint-solar.name: Vivint Solar
vivint-solar.description: Vivint Solar was an American company providing photovoltaic solar energy systems mainly for residential customers. Founded in 2011 as an offshoot of Vivint, it was headquartered in Lehi, Utah. The company used a power purchase agreement model and was acquired by Sunrun in 2020.

viridien.name: Viridien
viridien.description: Viridien, formerly CGG, is a multinational technology, digital, and Earth data company. It specializes in addressing complex challenges related to natural resources, energy transition, and infrastructure. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

virbac.name: Virbac
virbac.description: Virbac is a French company dedicated to animal health, located in Carros near Nice. It was founded in 1968 by veterinarian Pierre-Richard Dick. The company operates in the healthcare sector focusing on animal health.

varta-ag.name: VARTA AG
varta-ag.description: VARTA AG is a German company that manufactures batteries for automotive, industrial, and consumer markets worldwide. It is based in Germany and serves global markets with its battery products.

var-energi.name: Vår Energi
var-energi.description: Vår Energi AS is a Norwegian oil and gas company headquartered in Stavanger, Norway. Established in 2018 from a merger between Eni Norway and Point Resources, it is publicly traded with Eni as the largest stockholder.

vusiongroup.name: VusionGroup
vusiongroup.description: Vusion provides digitalization services for positive commerce, serving over 350 large retailer groups worldwide across Europe, Asia, and North America.

verisign.name: Verisign
verisign.description: Verisign, Inc. is an American company based in Reston, Virginia, operating network infrastructure including two of the Internet's thirteen root nameservers. It manages authoritative registries for several generic and country-code top-level domains. Verisign supports key internet domain systems.

voss-veksel-og-landmandsbank.name: Voss Veksel- og Landmandsbank
voss-veksel-og-landmandsbank.description: Voss Veksel- og Landmandsbank, also known as Vekselbanken, is a Norwegian commercial bank located in Vossavangen, Voss Municipality. It is the only remaining independent commercial bank not merged into larger banks like DnB NOR or Nordea.

vontier.name: Vontier
vontier.description: Vontier Corporation is an industrial manufacturing company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. It owns brands including Gilbarco Veeder-Root, Matco Tools, and Teletrac Navman, along with subsidiaries like Hennessy Industries.

viatris.name: Viatris
viatris.description: Viatris Inc. is a global pharmaceutical and healthcare corporation headquartered in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, USA. It was formed through the merger of Mylan and Upjohn, a division of Pfizer, in November 2020.

vistra.name: Vistra
vistra.description: Vistra Corp. is an integrated retail electricity and power generation company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is the largest competitive power generator in the U.S., with a diverse portfolio including natural gas, coal, nuclear, solar, and battery energy storage facilities.

vbi-vaccines.name: VBI Vaccines
vbi-vaccines.description: VBI Vaccines was a U.S.-based pharmaceutical company that faced bankruptcy proceedings in 2024. The company experienced operational, financial, and organizational challenges, with criticisms regarding leadership, strategic direction, and employee management.

vulcan-energy-resources.name: Vulcan Energy Resources
vulcan-energy-resources.description: Vulcan Energy Resources is an Australian company specializing in lithium and renewable energy production. It focuses on producing lithium with a net-zero carbon footprint.

value-partners.name: Value Partners
value-partners.description: Value Partners Group Limited is an asset management company based in Hong Kong. It operates in the financial sector, focusing on managing investment assets for clients.

vakfbank.name: VakıfBank
vakfbank.description: VakıfBank is the second-largest bank in Turkey by asset size. It was established in 1954 and is currently led by CEO Abdi Serdar Üstünsalih. The bank operates within the Turkish financial sector.

vital-farms.name: Vital Farms
vital-farms.description: Vital Farms, Inc. is an American egg and butter brand founded in 2007 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. Its products are sold in over 23,500 stores across the United States.

vicat.name: Vicat
vicat.industry: Manufacture of cement, lime and plaster
vicat.description: Vicat SA is a French company manufacturing cement, aggregates, and ready-mix concrete. It operates across four continents in the construction materials industry.

valeo.name: Valeo
valeo.description: Valeo is a French global automotive supplier headquartered in France and listed on the Paris Stock Exchange. It supplies products to automakers and the aftermarket, with 186 production plants and 66 R&D centers worldwide.

villar-land.name: Villar Land
villar-land.description: Villar Land Holdings Corporation is a Philippine holding company with stakes in real estate and death care industries. It is associated with Manny Villar.

versant.name: Versant
versant.description: Versant Media Group, Inc., known as Versant, is an American multinational mass media and technology company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. Its technical operations and master control are located at CNBC's headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey.

vantiva.name: Vantiva
vantiva.description: Vantiva SA is a French multinational corporation providing technology products and services for the communication, media, and entertainment industries. Headquartered in Paris, it has offices in multiple countries including China, India, Belgium, the US, and Brazil.

vitasoy-international-holdings.name: Vitasoy International Holdings
vitasoy-international-holdings.description: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based beverage company founded in 1940. It produces a brand of beverages and desserts named Vita. The company is headquartered in Tuen Mun, New Territories, Hong Kong.

vanguard-international-semiconductor-cor.name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
vanguard-international-semiconductor-cor.description: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation (VIS) is a Taiwanese IC foundry service provider founded in 1994 in Hsinchu Science Park. It became publicly listed in 1998 with major shareholders including TSMC and the National Development Fund.

veon.name: VEON
veon.description: VEON Ltd. is a multinational telecommunications and digital services company headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange. The company operates in the telecommunications industry.

valvoline.name: Valvoline
valvoline.description: Valvoline Inc. is an American retail automotive services company based in Lexington, Kentucky. It licenses its name for automotive oils and lubricants and owns several car repair chains including Valvoline Instant Oil Change. It is the second-largest oil change service provider in the US with over 1,650 locations.

vodafone-idea.name: Vodafone Idea
vodafone-idea.description: Vodafone Idea is an Indian telecommunications company headquartered in Gandhinagar. It operates as an all-India integrated GSM mobile telephony service provider.

veeco.name: Veeco
veeco.description: Veeco Instruments Inc. is an American capital equipment supplier based in Plainview, New York. It designs and builds processing systems used in semiconductor and compound semiconductor manufacturing, data storage, and scientific markets for applications including advanced packaging and photonics.

vulcan-materials-company.name: Vulcan Materials Company
vulcan-materials-company.description: Vulcan Materials Company is an American construction materials producer based in Birmingham, Alabama. It is the largest producer of aggregate materials like gravel, crushed stone, and sand, serving multiple US states and nearby countries. The company developed a large quarry and seaport project on Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula.

vital-energy.name: Vital Energy
vital-energy.description: Vital Energy, Inc. is an American hydrocarbon exploration company incorporated in Delaware with its principal operational headquarters in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

vail-resorts.name: Vail Resorts
vail-resorts.description: Vail Resorts, Inc. is an American mountain resort company headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It owns and operates 42 mountain resorts across four countries, along with hotels, lodging, condominiums, golf courses, and other real estate holdings.

versar.name: Versar
versar.description: Versar, Inc. is a project management company founded in 1969 that provides technical and management support globally. It operates in engineering and construction management, environmental services, and professional services including project development, environmental solutions, and waste management.

virnetx.name: VirnetX
virnetx.description: VirnetX is a publicly traded Internet security software and technology company based in Zephyr Cove, Nevada. Founded in 2005, it holds a patent portfolio including U.S. and international patents in areas such as DNS and network communication.

voltari.name: Voltari
voltari.description: Voltari Corp is a U.S. company engaged in acquiring, financing, and leasing commercial real estate properties. It is headquartered in New York City at 767 Fifth Avenue.

veris-residential.name: Veris Residential
veris-residential.description: Veris Residential, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. It primarily invests in apartments in New Jersey and Boston, owning multiple apartment complexes and retail properties. The company is owned by Affinius Capital and Vista Hill Partners.

voltage.name: Voltage
voltage.description: Voltage Inc. is a Japanese developer and publisher of interactive story apps, including visual novels and otome games for iOS and Android. It previously developed games through its San Francisco-based subsidiary Voltage Entertainment USA.

vtech.name: VTech
vtech.description: VTech Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based electronics company founded in 1976. It manufactures cordless phones, baby monitors, electronic learning toys, and provides contract manufacturing services.

vivmark-residential.name: Vivmark Residential
vivmark-residential.description: Vivmark Residential is a real estate investment trust based in Arlington, Virginia, and Chicago, Illinois. It invests in apartments and, as of August 2026, owned or had investments in 184,000 rental apartments with over 11,100 under construction.

vericel.name: Vericel
vericel.description: Vericel Corporation is an American biopharmaceutical company formerly known as Aastrom Bio until October 2014. It was originally formed in 1989 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. The company is publicly traded and operates in the biotechnology sector.

voxeljet.name: Voxeljet
voxeljet.description: voxeljet AG is a German manufacturer of industrial 3D printing systems based in Friedberg near Augsburg. It develops and distributes printing systems and operates service centers for on-demand manufacturing of molds and models for metal casting in Germany, the USA, and China.

vipshop.name: Vipshop
vipshop.description: Vipshop is a Chinese e-commerce company operating the website VIP.com, specializing in online discount sales. It is based in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, and was listed on the New York Stock Exchange in 2012.

vapotherm.name: Vapotherm
vapotherm.description: Vapotherm Inc. is a medical device manufacturer based in Exeter, New Hampshire, United States. Founded in 1999, it created the first heated and humidified high flow therapy nasal cannula system.

ventas-inc.name: Ventas, Inc.
ventas-inc.description: Ventas, Inc. is a real estate investment trust specializing in owning and managing research, medicine, and healthcare facilities in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

varonis-systems.name: Varonis Systems
varonis-systems.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. is a software company headquartered in Miami, Florida. It provides a Data Security Platform that analyzes data and activity to remediate exposure in cloud and multi-cloud environments and various SaaS and IaaS applications.

vantris-energy.name: Vantris Energy
vantris-energy.description: Vantris Energy Berhad is a Malaysian integrated oil and gas services company headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. It was formed via a merger in 2012 and renamed Vantris Energy Berhad in 2025, operating in exploration, development, production, and other oil and gas services.

valhi-inc.name: Valhi, Inc.
valhi-inc.description: Valhi, Inc. is an American holding company founded in 1987 from the merger of LLC Corporation and Amalgamated Sugar Company. It operates through wholly and majority-owned subsidiaries in various industries and was a Fortune 1000 company as of 2014.

virgin-money-uk-plc.name: Virgin Money UK plc
virgin-money-uk-plc.description: Virgin Money is a British banking and financial services brand based in the United Kingdom. Since October 1, 2024, it has been owned by Nationwide Building Society. The company operates in the financial services sector.

visual-china-group.name: Visual China Group
visual-china-group.description: Visual China Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese photo and media agency established in 2000. It is the largest stock image and media footage provider in China and the third largest globally.

veeva-systems.name: Veeva Systems
veeva-systems.description: Veeva Systems Inc., headquartered in Pleasanton, California, provides cloud computing software, data, and consulting services for the life sciences industry. Its products are used to track drug development and pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

virtusa.name: Virtusa
virtusa.description: Virtusa Corporation is an American information technology services company based in Southborough, Massachusetts. It provides IT consulting, business consulting, and outsourcing services. The company was founded in 1996 in Sri Lanka.

viohalco.name: Viohalco
viohalco.description: Viohalco S.A. is a Greek heavy industry corporation established in 1937 and listed on the Athens Stock Exchange since 1947. It comprises multiple companies active in metal production and steel and aluminum trade. The company accounts for 7 percent of Greek exports and is included in the FTSE/Athex Large Cap index.

vishay-intertechnology.name: Vishay Intertechnology
vishay-intertechnology.description: Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. is an American manufacturer of discrete semiconductors and passive electronic components. Founded by Felix Zandman, it has manufacturing plants across Israel, Asia, Europe, and the Americas producing various electronic components including rectifiers, diodes, and resistors.

vertex-pharmaceuticals.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
vertex-pharmaceuticals.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated is an American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was among the first biotech firms to use rational drug design and maintains research facilities in San Diego and Oxfordshire, England.

veritiv.name: Veritiv
veritiv.description: Veritiv is a business-to-business provider of packaging, publishing, and hygiene products. Headquartered in Sandy Springs, Georgia, it operates 125 distribution centers throughout the United States and Mexico and is a subsidiary of Clayton, Dubilier & Rice.

viavi-solutions.name: VIAVI Solutions
viavi-solutions.description: Viavi Solutions Inc. is an American network test, measurement, and assurance technology company based in Chandler, Arizona. It manufactures testing and monitoring equipment for networks and develops optical technology for various applications.

verifone.name: VeriFone
verifone.description: Verifone, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New York City. It provides technology for electronic payment transactions and value-added services at the point of sale. Verifone serves various industries including financial, retail, hospitality, and healthcare, operating in the technology sector.

verastem-oncology.name: Verastem Oncology
verastem-oncology.description: Verastem, Inc., doing business as Verastem Oncology, is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It develops medicines to treat certain cancers and is a member of the NASDAQ Biotechnology Index.

vaxart.name: Vaxart
vaxart.description: Vaxart, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops oral recombinant vaccines delivered via temperature-stable tablets, eliminating the need for refrigeration and injections. Founded in 2004 and based in Delaware, it focuses on vaccines for norovirus, influenza, RSV, and HPV. The company became a wholly owned subsidiary of Aviragen Therapeutics in 2018 after a reverse merger.

valens-semiconductor.name: Valens Semiconductor
valens-semiconductor.description: Valens Semiconductor is an Israeli fabless manufacturing company supplying semiconductors for automotive and audio-video industries. It developed the first chipset compliant with the MIPI A-PHY standard and invented the technology behind the HDBaseT standard. The company is a member and co-founder of related industry alliances.

videndum.name: Videndum
videndum.description: Videndum plc is a British manufacturer of hardware and software for the film and photography industries. Based in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, it was founded in 1910 and is listed on the London Stock Exchange. The company was formerly known as Vinten and Vitec.

vizio.name: Vizio
vizio.description: Vizio, Inc. is an American company designing televisions, soundbars, and related accessories. Founded in 2002, it is based in Irvine, California. Since 2024, Vizio has been owned by Walmart.

vornado-realty-trust.name: Vornado Realty Trust
vornado-realty-trust.description: Vornado Realty Trust is an American real estate investment trust formed in Maryland in 1982, with its primary office in New York City. The company invests in office buildings and street retail properties in Manhattan.

virgin-galactic.name: Virgin Galactic
virgin-galactic.description: Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. is a British-American spaceflight company founded by Richard Branson and the Virgin Group conglomerate. Virgin Group retains an 11.9% stake through Virgin Investments Limited. The company operates in the space tourism industry.

vedanta-limited.name: Vedanta Limited
vedanta-limited.description: Vedanta Limited is an Indian multinational mining and metals company headquartered in Mumbai. Its main operations include zinc, silver, cobalt, nickel, and gold mining. The company operates in the mining industry.

vittoria-assicurazioni.name: Vittoria Assicurazioni
vittoria-assicurazioni.description: Vittoria Assicurazioni is an Italian company active in the insurance sector.

volaris.name: Volaris
volaris.description: Volaris is a Mexican ultra low-cost airline headquartered in Mexico City. It operates bases in multiple cities including Cancún and Guadalajara, serving domestic and international destinations across the Americas. Volaris is Mexico's largest airline by passenger numbers.

verkkokauppa-com.name: Verkkokauppa.com
verkkokauppa-com.description: Verkkokauppa.com Oyj is a Finnish online retailer located in Helsinki. Established in 1992, it operates four megastores and over 2500 pickup locations, offering home delivery and installation services.

vf-corporation.name: VF Corporation
vf-corporation.description: VF Corporation is an American apparel and footwear company founded in 1899 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It organizes its eleven brands into three categories: Outdoor, Active, and Work. The company operates in the clothing industry.

vibra-energia.name: Vibra Energia
vibra-energia.description: Vibra Energia is the largest distributor and marketer of petroleum derivatives and biofuels in Brazil and Latin America. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, it was a Petrobras subsidiary until 2021 and operates over 8,000 gas stations in Brazil.

varian-medical-systems.name: Varian Medical Systems
varian-medical-systems.description: Varian Medical Systems is an American company based in Palo Alto, California, that manufactures radiation oncology treatment devices and software. Its products include linear accelerators and software for cancer treatment and clinic management, with manufacturing sites worldwide.

valaris-plc.name: Valaris plc
valaris-plc.description: Valaris Limited is an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Houston, Texas, and incorporated in Bermuda. It is the largest offshore drilling and well drilling company globally, owning 52 rigs including jackup rigs, drillships, and semi-submersible platform drilling rigs.

valin-steel.name: Valin Steel
valin-steel.description: Hunan Valin Steel Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned company based in Changsha, founded in 1997. It engages in smelting, manufacturing, and selling iron, steel, and nonferrous metal products. The company was part of the SZSE 1000 Index as of 2016.

voya-financial.name: Voya Financial
voya-financial.description: Voya Financial is an American financial, retirement, investment, and insurance company based in New York City. It was spun off from ING Group in 2013 and rebranded as Voya Financial in 2014. Its predecessors entered the U.S. market in the 1970s through acquisitions.

virgin-australia-regional-airlines.name: Virgin Australia Regional Airlines
virgin-australia-regional-airlines.description: Virgin Australia Regional Airlines (VARA) is an Australian regional airline based in Perth. It services key towns in Western Australia and interstate destinations such as Adelaide and Darwin. Formerly known as Skywest, it was purchased by Virgin Australia Holdings in April 2013.

volcan.name: Volcan
volcan.description: Volcan Compañía Minera S.A.A. is a mining company based in Peru. The company operates in the mining industry within the country.

via-technologies.name: VIA Technologies
via-technologies.description: VIA Technologies, Inc. is a Taiwanese fabless semiconductor company that manufactures integrated circuits including motherboard chipsets, CPUs, and memory. It was once the world's largest independent manufacturer of motherboard chipsets and outsources silicon manufacturing to third-party foundries like TSMC.

visteon.name: Visteon
visteon.description: Visteon Corporation is an American global automotive electronics technology company headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan. It designs, engineers, and manufactures vehicle cockpit electronics, connected car services, and electrification products for automotive manufacturers worldwide.

victorias-milling-company.name: Victorias Milling Company
victorias-milling-company.description: Victorias Milling Company is a publicly listed Philippine company established in 1919. It is the largest sugar producer in the country and one of Asia's largest sugar millers and refineries. Its plant facilities and headquarters are located in Victorias City, Negros Occidental.

virgin-america.name: Virgin America
virgin-america.description: Virgin America Inc. was a low-cost airline headquartered in Burlingame, California, in the San Francisco Bay Area. It operated domestic and international flights with hubs in San Francisco and Los Angeles, focusing on West Coast cities and major metropolitan areas. It also had focus city operations in Dallas and New York.

vueling.name: Vueling
vueling.description: Vueling S.A. is a Spanish low-cost airline based in Viladecans near Barcelona. It operates mainly from Barcelona–El Prat Airport and has secondary bases in several European cities. Since 2013, it has been part of International Airlines Group, which also owns British Airways and Iberia.

vienna-insurance-group.name: Vienna Insurance Group
vienna-insurance-group.description: Vienna Insurance Group AG Wiener Versicherung Gruppe (VIG) is an international insurance group headquartered in Vienna, Austria. It is one of the largest insurance groups in Central and Eastern Europe with approximately 25,000 employees.

vision-values-holdings-limited.name: Vision Values Holdings Limited
vision-values-holdings-limited.description: Vision Values Holdings Limited is a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed company. It underwent two backdoor listings and was formerly known as New World Mobile Holdings, Asia Logistics Technologies, and Wah Yik Holdings.

vse-corporation.name: VSE Corporation
vse-corporation.description: VSE Corporation provides aftermarket distribution and repair services, enhancing productivity and longevity of business-critical assets. It operates aviation and fleet segments, offering parts distribution, maintenance, and supply chain management services.

vwr-international.name: VWR International
vwr-international.description: VWR International is an American distributor of research laboratory products headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It serves government, biotechnology, life science, education, electronics, and pharmaceutical sectors, operating in 25 countries as of 2010.

vaalco-energy.name: Vaalco Energy
vaalco-energy.description: VAALCO Energy is a hydrocarbon exploration company organized in Delaware and headquartered in Houston, Texas. Its operations are primarily in the Etame Marin block offshore Gabon.

valmont-industries.name: Valmont Industries
valmont-industries.description: Valmont Industries, Inc. is a large American manufacturer of irrigation equipment, windmill support structures, lighting and traffic poles, and steel utility poles.

vector-group.name: Vector Group
vector-group.description: Vector Group Ltd. was an American diversified holding company with major businesses including Liggett Group (tobacco) and New Valley. In 2024, it was acquired by Japan Tobacco to become a wholly owned subsidiary.

vector-limited.name: Vector Limited
vector-limited.description: Vector Limited is a New Zealand energy company that operates a portfolio of businesses delivering energy and communication services across Australasia and the Pacific. Its primary business includes electricity and piped gas distribution. The company also owns a fibre optic cable network and offers cybersecurity services and a data platform.

vectren.name: Vectren
vectren.description: Vectren Corporation was a Fortune 1000 energy holding company based in Evansville, Indiana. It distributed natural gas and electricity to customers in Indiana and Ohio and operated coal-fired generating capacity. The company also provided energy-related products and services throughout the Midwest and Southeast.

veloxis-pharmaceuticals.name: Veloxis Pharmaceuticals
veloxis-pharmaceuticals.description: Veloxis Pharmaceuticals A/S is a Danish pharmaceutical company focused on developing improved drug formulations using its MeltDose® technology. It is building a clinical and market-stage business around its transplant immunosuppression product candidate LCP-Tacro. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Hørsholm, Denmark.

vera-bradley.name: Vera Bradley
vera-bradley.description: Vera Bradley Sales, LLC is an American travel gear design company founded in 1982 and based in Roanoke, Indiana. It produces luxury cotton bags and has expanded into fashion, home accessories, office supplies, and patterned gifts. The company is known for its distinctive floral and geometric prints inspired by French Provençal fabrics.

verenium-corporation.name: Verenium Corporation
verenium-corporation.description: Verenium Corporation was a San Diego-based industrial biotechnology company founded in 2007 from a merger. It specialized in developing high performance enzymes for industrial applications such as biofuel generation and hydraulic fracturing. The company was acquired by BASF in 2013.

verint-systems.name: Verint Systems
verint-systems.description: Verint Systems Inc. is a technology company based in Melville, New York, that provides products and services for customer experience automation. Its offerings include AI, advanced analytics, and automated workflows to analyze business intelligence from customer interactions across various channels. The company helps organizations improve productivity and service quality.

verisk-analytics.name: Verisk Analytics
verisk-analytics.description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. is an American multinational data analytics and risk assessment firm headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. Its services cover fraud prevention, actuarial science, insurance coverage, fire protection, catastrophe and weather risk, and data management.

viasat.name: Viasat
viasat.description: Viasat, Inc. is an American satellite communications company headquartered in Carlsbad, California. It provides satellite broadband and narrowband connectivity and communications equipment for various sectors including commercial aviation, maritime, enterprise, consumer, military, and government. The company operates satellites in multiple frequency bands and uses partner satellite networks.

vicor-corporation.name: Vicor Corporation
vicor-corporation.description: Vicor Corporation is a manufacturer of power modules headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, United States. It operates in the electronics industry.

viktor-lenac-shipyard.name: Viktor Lenac Shipyard
viktor-lenac-shipyard.description: The Viktor Lenac Shipyard is located on the northern Croatian Adriatic coast near the largest Croatian port. Founded in 1896, it was among the first to perform ship lengthenings and is listed on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.

vinda-international.name: Vinda International
vinda-international.description: Vinda International Holdings Limited is a major Asian hygiene company specializing in tissue paper and personal care products. Founded in 1985, it operates in multiple Asian markets and several countries worldwide.

virtu-financial.name: Virtu Financial
virtu-financial.description: Virtu Financial, Inc. is an American electronic market making company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City. It operates in the financial services sector.

virtus-investment-partners.name: Virtus Investment Partners
virtus-investment-partners.description: Virtus Investment Partners, Inc. is an American multi-manager asset management company comprising affiliated managers with distinct investment processes and brands, as well as unaffiliated sub advisers.

vista-entertainment-solutions.name: Vista Entertainment Solutions
vista-entertainment-solutions.description: Vista Group International Limited is a multinational technology company providing software for film distribution, exhibition, and analytics. It has over 700 staff worldwide and its software is installed in cinemas across 116 countries.

vitacost.name: Vitacost
vitacost.description: Vitacost.com, Inc. is an American e-commerce company based in Boca Raton, Florida. It sells vitamins, supplements, and organic grocery products. The company was acquired by iHerb on January 8, 2026.

vitesse-semiconductor.name: Vitesse Semiconductor
vitesse-semiconductor.description: Vitesse Semiconductor was a fabless American semiconductor company based in Camarillo, California. It developed high-performance Ethernet integrated circuit solutions for carrier and enterprise networks. The company was acquired by Microsemi Corporation in 2015.

vivus.name: Vivus
vivus.description: Vivus is a small pharmaceutical company headquartered in Campbell, California. It specializes in obesity, sleep, and sexual health, and developed Avanafil, an FDA-approved erectile dysfunction drug sold under the name Stendra.

vocaltec.name: VocalTec
vocaltec.description: VocalTec Communications Inc. is an Israeli telecom equipment provider founded in 1985. The company patented the first Voice over IP audio transceiver and has supplied major customers such as Deutsche Telekom and Telecom Italia.

vringo.name: Vringo
vringo.description: Vringo was a technology company involved in worldwide patent litigation, including a notable 2012 lawsuit against Google. The company pursued intellectual property cases against multiple large corporations across various countries.

vulcabras.name: Vulcabras
vulcabras.description: Vulcabrasǀazaleia is a Brazilian footwear company founded in 1952 and currently headquartered in Jundiaí. It is the third largest footwear company in the domestic market and Latin America.

vuzix.name: Vuzix
vuzix.description: Vuzix Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Rochester, New York. It supplies smartglasses and augmented reality display technology for applications including gaming, training, and military use.

vanke.name: Vanke
vanke.description: Vanke is a large residential real estate developer in China engaged in developing, managing, and selling properties across more than 60 mainland Chinese cities. Since 2012, it has expanded into Hong Kong, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Malaysia. Its largest shareholder is Shenzhen Metro.

virgin-australia-holdings.name: Virgin Australia Holdings
virgin-australia-holdings.description: Virgin Australia Holdings Limited is an Australian holding company that owns and operates Virgin Australia and Virgin Australia Regional Airlines. Its head office is located in South Bank, Brisbane. It previously operated several other airlines that were absorbed into Virgin Australia in 2011.

veritone-inc.name: Veritone Inc.
veritone-inc.description: Veritone, Inc. is an American artificial intelligence technology company founded in 2014 and based in Irvine, California. It provides AI software services to public and private sectors including media, government, and law enforcement.

vantage-towers.name: Vantage Towers
vantage-towers.description: Vantage Towers is a European infrastructure company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. It specializes in the construction, management, and leasing of towers, antenna masts, and related facilities to mobile network operators.

virgin-group.name: Virgin Group
virgin-group.description: Virgin Group Limited is a British multinational venture capital conglomerate based in London, England. Founded by Richard Branson and Nik Powell in February 1970, it is classified as a holding company with commercial activities dating back to the 1970s.

vivo.name: Vivo
vivo.description: Vivo Brazil is a telecommunications brand owned by Telefônica Brasil, a subsidiary of the Spanish company Telefónica. It is the largest telecommunications company in Brazil and is headquartered in the Brooklin Novo neighborhood of São Paulo.

veidekke.name: Veidekke
veidekke.description: Veidekke is the largest Norwegian construction and civil engineering company and the fourth largest in Scandinavia. It operates across Scandinavia in construction, engineering, rehabilitation, and development of dwellings and public buildings. The company also manages asphalt operations, aggregates production, and public road maintenance.

villeroy-boch.name: Villeroy & Boch
villeroy-boch.description: Villeroy & Boch is a German manufacturer of ceramic goods headquartered in Mettlach, Saarland. Founded in 1748, the company has 15 production sites in Europe and Asia and sells products in around 140 countries.

vozrozhdenie-bank.name: Vozrozhdenie Bank
vozrozhdenie-bank.description: Vozrozhdenie Bank was a Russian bank founded in 1991 and headquartered in Moscow. It provided personal banking and business services to clients in Russia.

viettel-tanzania.name: Viettel Tanzania
viettel-tanzania.description: Viettel Tanzania Public Limited Company, trading as Halotel, is a mobile communications company in Tanzania. Owned by Viettel Global JSC from Vietnam, it provides voice, messaging, data, and communication services. It was the first company in Tanzania allowed to lay its own fiber optic cable, covering all 26 regions.

venezuelan-red-cross.name: Venezuelan Red Cross
venezuelan-red-cross.description: The Venezuelan Red Cross Society was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Avenida Andrés Bello in Caracas, Venezuela. Its first president was Briton Vincent Kennett-Barrington. It operates as an emergency and relief organization.

vizrt.name: Vizrt
vizrt.description: Vizrt is a Norwegian vendor of broadcast technology known for its real-time broadcast graphics software powered by the Viz Engine. Formed from a merger between Peak Broadcast Systems and RT-SET, its products include 3D graphics systems, sports analysis, media asset management, and workflow systems for digital broadcasting.

vallibel-one.name: Vallibel One
vallibel-one.description: Vallibel One PLC is one of Sri Lanka's largest conglomerates, listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 2011. It controls subsidiaries including LB Finance, Royal Ceramics Lanka, and Delmege Group. The company was included in the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index in 2018.

vsmpo-avisma.name: VSMPO-AVISMA
vsmpo-avisma.description: VSMPO-AVISMA Corporation is a Russian mining company and the world's third-largest producer of titanium sponge. It operates facilities in multiple countries including Russia, Ukraine, England, Switzerland, Germany, and the United States. The company produces titanium, aluminum, magnesium, and steel alloys and serves aerospace companies globally.

vesuvius-plc.name: Vesuvius plc
vesuvius-plc.description: Vesuvius plc is a British engineered ceramics company headquartered in London. Its products serve steelmakers, foundries, glass, and solar energy industries. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

vardia-insurance-group.name: Vardia Insurance Group
vardia-insurance-group.description: Vardia Insurance Group is a Norwegian insurance company headquartered in Oslo. It operates in Norway, Sweden, and Denmark and was listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange in 2014.

viaplay-group.name: Viaplay Group
viaplay-group.description: Viaplay Group AB, formerly Nordic Entertainment Group AB, is a Swedish media and entertainment company headquartered in Stockholm.

valley-national-bank.name: Valley National Bank
valley-national-bank.description: Valley National Bancorp, known as Valley Bank, is a regional bank holding company headquartered in Morristown, New Jersey. It operates over 230 branches across several U.S. states and is one of the largest commercial banks headquartered in New Jersey.

veresen.name: Veresen
veresen.description: Veresen Inc. was a Calgary, Alberta-based energy infrastructure company with businesses in pipelines, natural gas, and power generation. It was publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange and was formerly known as Fort Chicago Energy Partners L.P. In 2017, it was acquired by Pembina Pipeline.

victrex.name: Victrex
victrex.description: Victrex plc is a British supplier of high performance polymers with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in the UK. It serves industries such as aerospace, automotive, and medical across more than 40 countries.

vigor-s-a.name: Vigor S.A.
vigor-s-a.description: Vigor S.A. is a Brazilian dairy and food company headquartered in São Paulo. It is the sixth largest dairy company in Brazil and a subsidiary of Mexican firm Grupo Lala.

vonage.name: Vonage
vonage.description: Vonage Holdings Corp. is an American cloud communications provider headquartered in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. Founded in 1998 as Min-X, it provides residential telecommunications services based on voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP). It operates as a subsidiary of Ericsson.

vigo-photonics.name: VIGO Photonics
vigo-photonics.description: Vigo Photonics is a Polish electronics company specializing in photonic integrated circuits and epitaxial wafers. It operates within the semiconductor industry and is based in Poland.

verve-international.name: Verve International
verve-international.description: Verve International is a Nigerian Pan-African and multinational financial technology and payment card brand. It is owned by the Interswitch Group. The company operates in the financial services sector.

vodafone-ghana.name: Vodafone Ghana
vodafone-ghana.description: Vodafone Ghana, formerly Ghana Telecom, is the national telecommunications company of Ghana. In February 2024, it was fully rebranded to Telecel Ghana.

video-brinquedo.name: Vídeo Brinquedo
video-brinquedo.description: Vídeo Brinquedo is a Brazilian animation studio based in São Paulo. It is known for producing animated films considered to be inexpensive mockbusters of more successful films from major studios like Walt Disney and Pixar. The company operates in the animation sector.

votorantim-group.name: Votorantim Group
votorantim-group.description: Votorantim S.A. is a permanently capitalized investment holding company based in Brazil. It has a long-term investment approach with portfolio companies operating in 16 countries across sectors including building materials, finance, aluminum, renewable energy, metals, mining, orange juice, steel, real estate, and infrastructure.

vale-fertilizantes.name: Vale Fertilizantes
vale-fertilizantes.description: Vale Fertilizantes is a Brazilian fertilizer company founded in 2010 after Vale acquired Fosfertil. It operates in the agriculture sector, producing fertilizers for the Brazilian market. The company is a subsidiary of the mining giant Vale.

volkswagen-trucks-and-buses.name: Volkswagen Trucks and Buses
volkswagen-trucks-and-buses.description: Volkswagen Truck & Bus Indústria e Comércio de Veículos Ltda. is a Brazilian commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Resende, Brazil. It is a subsidiary of Traton and produces heavy trucks and buses under the Volkswagen brand.

volkswagen-do-brasil.name: Volkswagen do Brasil
volkswagen-do-brasil.description: Volkswagen do Brasil Ltda. is a subsidiary of Volkswagen Group established in 1953. It assembled the Volkswagen Type 1 locally and produced over 20 million vehicles in Brazil, leading the market for most of its existence.

vergelegen.name: Vergelegen
vergelegen.description: Vergelegen is a historic wine estate located in Somerset West, Western Cape province, South Africa. It operates within the winemaking industry.

volkswagen-argentina.name: Volkswagen Argentina
volkswagen-argentina.description: Volkswagen Group Argentina is the Argentine subsidiary of the German automotive manufacturer Volkswagen Group. Established in 1980, it acquired Chrysler Fevre Argentina and its two plants in San Justo and Monte Chingolo.

vassalli-fabril.name: Vassalli Fabril
vassalli-fabril.description: Vassalli Fabril S.A. is an Argentina-based company producing combine harvesters and farm implements under the brands Vassalli and Don Roque. It has three manufacturing plants in Firmat, Santa Fe Province, with a production capacity of 600 units a year.

viva-air-peru.name: Viva Air Peru
viva-air-peru.description: Viva Air Perú S.A.C. was a Peruvian ultra low-cost carrier created by Irelandia Aviation. It is related to Viva Air Colombia and Mexico's VivaAerobús, although the latter has no legal affiliation with the other Viva brands.

venezolana.name: Venezolana
venezolana.description: Venezolana - Rutas Aéreas de Venezuela S.A. is a charter airline headquartered in Maracaibo, Venezuela. It operates as a Venezuelan airline providing charter services.

venirauto.name: Venirauto
venirauto.description: Venirauto Industrias C.A. is an automobile manufacturing company based in Venezuela. It produces vehicles within the country as part of the automotive industry.

vit-c-a.name: VIT, C.A.
vit-c-a.description: VIT, C.A. is a Venezuelan manufacturer of desktop computers and laptops, supported by the Venezuelan government and Chinese IT company Inspur. Their first computer was the Computador Bolivariano, which came with the Kubuntu Linux operating system.

viva-air-colombia.name: Viva Air Colombia
viva-air-colombia.description: Fast Colombia S.A.S., trading as Viva Air Colombia, was a Colombian ultra low-cost airline based in Rionegro, Antioquia. It was a subsidiary of Irelandia Aviation and was the third largest airline in Colombia before ceasing operations in 2023. The airline had a codeshare agreement with Mexico's Viva Aerobus.

viva-bolivia.name: Viva (Bolivia)
viva-bolivia.description: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones Nuevatel PCS de Bolivia S.A., known as VIVA, is a Bolivian wireless network operator and telecommunications company founded in 1999. It is among the largest companies in Bolivia and the third-largest wireless carrier with a 12.9% market share.

volaris-costa-rica.name: Volaris Costa Rica
volaris-costa-rica.description: Vuela Aviacion S.A., operating as Volaris Costa Rica, is a low-cost airline based at Juan Santamaría International Airport in San José, Costa Rica. It is a subsidiary of the Mexican airline Volaris. The airline began operations in November 2016 with flights to Guatemala City.

vuhl.name: VUHL
vuhl.description: VUHL is a manufacturer of high performance automobiles headquartered in Mexico. The company was founded by brothers Guillermo and Iker Echeverria.

volkswagen-de-mexico.name: Volkswagen de México
volkswagen-de-mexico.description: Volkswagen de México is the Mexican subsidiary of Volkswagen Group, operating the group's plants and leasing and banking companies in Mexico. The company is headquartered in Puebla city and manages manufacturing and financial services related to Volkswagen in Mexico.

viva.name: Viva
viva.description: Viva, officially Aeroenlaces Nacionales, is a major Mexican low-cost airline headquartered at Monterrey International Airport. It is Mexico's third-largest airline by passenger numbers and serves over 50 destinations across Mexico, the US, Central, and South America.
